title: Host's father dreamed of an earthquake on January 17th before the Northridge quake

tellings.quote: in it he talks about how he would always dream of an earthquake on Jan January 17th

plain: Michels's father is said to have dreamed again and again of an earthquake on January 17th, before the Northridge earthquake struck Los Angeles on that date in 1994. Michels tells this himself, while talking with the writer Eric Wargo about prophetic dreams, and says his father writes about it in his book The Tools. If true, it would be a case of a dream foreseeing a real disaster.
